messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "title": "Checkbox requirement causes user lockouts",
 "problem_statement": "Handlers are frequently locked out of the system because they miss a confusing checkbox requirement. This prevents them from processing claims and disrupts their workflow.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "quote": "we’ve had two handlers locked out already this week just from missing a checkbox.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-25T14:19:00+00:00"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The title and problem statement claim that a confusing checkbox requirement frequently locks handlers out, blocking claim processing. The single support quote from 2026-10-25 corroborates this with a concrete instance of two handlers locked out in one week due to missing the checkbox. This is a product usability/flow issue a squad could act on, not a pricing, contract, or customer-IT issue, and no help article or workaround is mentioned as resolving it.", "verdict": "pass"}
